```{r}
DRAM_KOs = as.data.frame(DRAM_pathways$gene_id)
colnames(DRAM_KOs) = "gene_id"
```

```{r}
filenames = list.files(path = "/scratch/users/rsalcedo/orca_RSG/bin_analysis/kofamscan/csv_processed/")
setwd("/scratch/users/rsalcedo/orca_RSG/bin_analysis/kofamscan/csv_processed/")

for (f in filenames) {
  genome = fread(f)  
  if (!"KO" %in% colnames(genome)) {
    stop(paste("Column 'KO' not found in file:", f))
  }
  genome = genome[, .(gene_id = KO, present = 1)]
  new_col_name = sub("\\_processed\\.csv$", "", f)
  setnames(genome, "present", new_col_name)
  genome = genome[!duplicated(gene_id)]
  genome = merge(DRAM_KOs, genome, by = "gene_id", all.x = TRUE)
  assign(paste0("genome_", new_col_name), genome)
}
```


```{r}
#get all data frames in list
df_list = mget(ls(pattern = "genome_O"))
#clean up the names so its just the bin ID
names(df_list) <- sub("\\_processed.csv$", "", names(df_list))
#merge all the dataframes together
a = do.call("cbind", df_list)

colnames(a)[1] = "KO"

#clean up df by renaming some files and dropping duplicate columns
colnames(a)[1] = "KO"
ab <- a %>% select(-contains(".gene_id"))

#reorder the KO columns so theyre in the same order for when you do cbind since that doesnt look for matches. had to do it this way since merge wasnt working (gave too many rows)
DRAM_pathways = DRAM_pathways[order(DRAM_pathways$gene_id,decreasing=TRUE),]
ab = ab[order(ab$KO,decreasing=TRUE),]
ab = cbind(ab, DRAM_pathways)

#dropping duplicate rows, renaming column headers, and replacing NAs with zeros
ab <- ab %>% select(-contains("gene_id"))
ab[is.na(ab)] <- 0
colnames(ab) = gsub("\\..*", "", colnames(ab))
```

```{r}
ab_long = ab %>% pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("genome_"), names_to = "genome", values_to = "present")
ab_long$genome = sub("genome_", "", ab_long$genome)

ab_long = left_join(ab_long, genome_info, by = "genome")
ab_drep = filter(ab_long, ab_long$drep_rep == "TRUE")

#drop K00441 since its not energy producing
ab_drep = ab_drep[-(which(ab_drep$KO == "K00441")),]

#check MAG numbers
length(unique(ab_long$genome))
length(unique(ab_drep$genome))
```

cleaning up df for plotting
```{r}
ab_drep <- ab_drep %>%
  mutate(
    phylum = sub(".*p__", "", sub("\\;c.*", "", classification)),
    class = sub(".*c__", "", sub("\\;o.*", "", classification)),
    label = paste(phylum, class, sep = "\n")
  )
```

```{r}
coverm_info = read.csv(paste0(rootdir, "bin_analysis/coverm/coverm_info.csv"))
active_MAGs_list <- coverm_info %>%
  filter(amplified == "yes" & covered_fraction >= 0.5) %>%
  pull(genome) %>%
  unique()

active_MAGs_list <- active_MAGs_list[active_MAGs_list != "Orca-CTD10BTL6_S511_19"]

active_MAGs = ab_drep %>%
  filter(genome %in% active_MAGs_list) %>% 
  filter(gene_type == "marker" | metabolism == "transport") %>%
  filter(present == 1)

active_MAGs <- active_MAGs %>%
  filter(
    !( 
      (KO %in% c("K10944", "K10945", "K10946") & genome == "Orca-CTD5BTL4_S510_5" & header == "methane") |
      (KO %in% c("K10944", "K10945", "K10946", "K10535") & genome == "Orca-CTD5BTL4_S510_5" & module == "Complete nitrification") |
      (KO %in% c("K00368") & genome == "Orca-CTD5BTL4_S510_5" & module == "Denitrification") |
      (KO %in% c("K00368") & genome == "Orca-CTD5BTL4_S510_5" & module == "Annamox") |
      (KO %in% c("K00958") & genome == "Orca-CTD5BTL4_S510_5" & module == "Sulfite oxidation") |
      (KO %in% c("K00194") & genome == "Orca-CTD5BTL4_S510_1" & module == "anaerobic CO oxidation")
    )
  )

active_coverm = coverm_info %>%
  filter(amplified == "yes" & covered_fraction >= 0.5)

write.csv(active_coverm, paste0(rootdir, "/output_csvs/active_coverm.csv"))
```

```{r}

module_colors <- c("Wood-Ljungdahl pathway" = "#800000", "Dicarboxylate-hydroxybutylate cycle" = "#B84B4B", "Hydroxypropionate-hydroxybutylate cycle" = "#B84B4B", "Ammonia oxidation" = "springgreen2", "Complete nitrification" = "springgreen4", "Branched-chain amino acid degradation" = "royalblue4", "biotin synthesis" = "lightskyblue", "glycine cleavage system" = "lightsteelblue3", "hydrogen peroxide dismutation" = "gray", "Sulfite oxidation" = "palegreen")

active_MAGs$header <- factor(active_MAGs$header, levels = c("ABC Transporter", "HICF", "Glycine", "Autotrophy", "Nitrogen", "Sulfur", "ROS"))

# Custom KO list

ko_mapping <- data.frame(
  KO = c("K15023", "K15016", "K10946", "K10945", "K10944", "K10535", "K04564", "K02437", "K01999", "K01935", "K00826", "K00605", "K00394", "K00382", "K00283", "K00194"),
  Name = c("acsE", "ECH/HAD", "amoC", "amoB", "amoA", "hao", "SOD2", "gcvH", "livK", "bioD", "ilvE", "gcvT", "aprA", "pdhD", "gcvPB", "acsD") # Names associated with KOs
)

data <- merge(active_MAGs, ko_mapping, by = "KO")

ggplot(data, aes(x = Name, y = genome, fill = module, alpha = present)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  facet_grid(label ~ header, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "y") +
  scale_alpha_identity(guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = module_colors) + 
  ylab("Genomes") +
  xlab("KO Number") +
  theme_few() +
  theme(
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y.left = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y.left = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, size = 10),  # Move y-axis facet labels to the left
    strip.text.x.top = element_text(angle = 0, size = 12)
  ) + 
  guides(shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2)),
         color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2)))
```
